collections.title: Classical & Ancient Centers
collections.summary: The foundational centers of classical triangle geometry: the incenter, centroid, circumcenter, orthocenter, nine-point center, symmedian point, Gergonne, Nagel, Mittenpunkt, Spieker, Feuerbach, Fermat, isodynamic, Napoleon, and Clawson points.

collections.title: Euler Line Centers
collections.summary: Classical centers lying on the Euler line X_2 X_3, including the De Longchamps point, Schiffler point, Exeter point, far-out point, homothetic center of the orthic and tangential triangles, and the Euler infinity point.

collections.title: Power Points, Circle Similicenters & Named Centers
collections.summary: 2nd and 3rd power points, the Bevan point, Brocard midpoint, Kosnita point, and internal and external centers of similitude of the circumcircle, incircle, and nine-point circle.

collections.title: Isogonal & Isotomic Conjugates of Classical Centers
collections.summary: Isogonal conjugates (X_59–X_74) and isotomic and cross conjugates (X_75–X_97) of the classical centers X_1–X_58.

collections.title: Centers on the Circumcircle
collections.summary: Notable points on the circumcircle of ABC, including the Tarry point, Steiner point, anticomplementary, Feuerbach, Kiepert, and Jerabek antipodes, and centers derived from circumcircle mappings.

collections.title: Centers on the Nine-Point Circle & Orthic Centers
collections.summary: Points on the nine-point circle (X_113–X_139), centers of the Kiepert, Feuerbach, and Jerabek rectangular hyperbolas, and centers transferred to the orthic triangle.

collections.title: Derived Triangle Centers, Isoscelizers & Ajima-Malfatti Points
collections.summary: Complements, anticomplements, and classical centers evaluated on the medial, orthic, tangential, and excentral triangles, together with congruent isoscelizer, equal detour, and Ajima-Malfatti points.

collections.title: Ceva Conjugates
collections.summary: Perspectors of the cevian triangle of P and the anticevian triangle of Q (P-Ceva conjugates of Q) for classical triangle centers.

collections.title: Line Conjugates
collections.summary: Intersections of line PQ with the trilinear polar of the isogonal conjugate of P (P-line conjugates of Q).

collections.title: Isogonal Conjugates II & Hirst Inverses
collections.summary: Isogonal conjugates of centers X_115–X_248, together with cross conjugates and X_2-Hirst inverses.

collections.title: Isotomic Conjugates II
collections.summary: Isotomic conjugates of previously cataloged triangle centers, together with X_2-Hirst inverses and radical centers.

collections.title: Parry Circle, Morley/Yff Centers & Pedal Centroids
collections.summary: The Parry circle center, Morley trisector centers, Yff equal-parallelians, trisected-perimeter, and equilateral-cevian points, Kenmotu point, and centroids of pedal and cevian triangles.

collections.title: Euler Line Substitutions & Hirst Inverses
collections.summary: Centers lying on the Euler line generated by X_k-substitutions and Hirst inversions, followed by the Tixier point, Ajima-Malfatti radical center, and Evans perspectors.

collections.title: Vecten Square Centers & Isoscelizer Centers
collections.summary: Inner and outer Vecten points and square-associated centers (Vierkanten in een driehoek, X_485–X_495), harmonic conjugates, and isoscelizer-associated centers (X_503–X_510).

collections.title: Centers on the Line at Infinity & Vector Directions
collections.summary: Points on the line at infinity x + y + z = 0 (X_511–X_526, isogonal conjugates of circumcircle points), unit vector direction centers, and classical midpoints.

collections.title: Brocard Axis Circles & Gibert Centers
collections.summary: Centers on the Brocard axis X_3 X_6 whose circles cut equal chords on the sidelines of ABC (X_566–X_584), congruent shrunk insquares points, and centers contributed by Bernard Gibert (X_616–X_642).

collections.title: Crossdifferences & Trilinear Poles
collections.summary: Trilinear multipliers for the Kiepert and Yff parabolas, crossdifferences of classical centers, and trilinear poles of central lines.

collections.title: Even (p, q) Circumcircle Points
collections.summary: Even trigonometric (p, q) points on the circumcircle and line at infinity, paired with their isogonal conjugates.

collections.title: Odd o-(p, q) Circumcircle Points
collections.summary: Odd trigonometric o-(p, q) points on the circumcircle and line at infinity, paired with their isogonal conjugates.

collections.title: Hatzipolakis-Yiu Centers, Hirst Inverses & Crossdifferences
collections.summary: Hatzipolakis-Yiu points, the Yiu angle point (X_848), Kiepert hyperbola multipliers, Hirst inverses, and Euler line intercepts.

collections.title: Star-Named Centers, Ehrmann Points & Anticomplements
collections.summary: Star-named centers (Agena, Achernar, Algenib, Alcor), Ehrmann points, anticomplements, and midpoints of classical triangle centers.

collections.title: Classical Midpoints, Euler Intercepts & Cevapoints
collections.summary: Midpoints of classical centers, Euler line intercepts, collinearity intersections, cevapoints, and pure-angle trilinear centers.

collections.title: Cross Conjugates, Trilinear Squares & Euler-Circumcircle Intersections
collections.summary: Cross conjugates, trilinear squares and cubes of classical centers, and the intersections of the Euler line with the circumcircle (X_1113, X_1114).

collections.title: Morley-Taylor-Marr, Hofstadter, Ehrmann & Star Centers
collections.summary: Morley-Taylor-Marr centers, Hofstadter points, the Ehrmann congruent squares point (X_1144), Grebe triangle centers, and star-named points (Aldebaran, Algjebbah, Altair, Altais).

collections.title: Saragossa Points
collections.summary: 1st, 2nd, and 3rd Saragossa points (Q, Q', Q'') constructed from the cevian and circumcevian triangles of classical centers.

collections.title: Saragossa Conjugates, Sharygin Points & Lemoine Homothetic Center
collections.summary: Isogonal and isotomic conjugates of the Saragossa points, Sharygin points, and the Lemoine homothetic center (X_1285).

collections.title: Collings Transforms
collections.summary: Concurrence points on the circumcircle of the circumcircles of AB'C', A'BC', and A'B'C, where A'B'C' is the reflection of ABC in P.

collections.title: Moses Intersections, Circumcircle Inverses, Wernau Points & Similicenters
collections.summary: Moses orthocentroidal-Euler intersections, circumcircle inverses, 1st and 2nd Wernau points (X_1337, X_1338), and similicenters of the circumcircle, nine-point circle, orthocentroidal circle, and Brocard circle.

collections.title: Brisse Transforms, Rigby/Griffiths Points & Complementary Conjugates
collections.summary: Polynomial centers on the incircle generated by the Brisse transform (X_1354–X_1367), Rigby and Griffiths points, and complementary and anticomplementary conjugates.

collections.title: Beth Conjugates & Harmonic Conjugates
collections.summary: Fixed-point P-beth conjugates of P and harmonic conjugates along central lines.

collections.title: Johnson-Yff Circle, Perspectors & Star-Named Centers
collections.summary: The Johnson-Yff circle center, tangential-of-tangential perspectors, star-named centers (Bellatrix, Betelgeuse, Biham), and Napoleon and Fermat crosssums.

collections.title: Orthojoins, Moses Circle Centers & Star-Named Centers
collections.summary: Orthojoins H(X) — orthopoles of the trilinear polars of isogonal conjugates (X_1512–X_1568) — together with Moses circle similicenters and star-named centers (Capella, Caph, Cebalrai, Celaeno, Chertan, Chort).

collections.title: TCC-Perspectors & Tripolar Centroids
collections.summary: Perspectors of the tangential triangle and the circumcevian triangle of P (X_1601–X_1634), tripolar centroids (X_1635–X_1651), and Evans and Grinberg perspectors.

collections.title: Circle-Related Points
collections.summary: Internal and external centers of similitude among the circumcircle, incircle, nine-point circle, Brocard circle, 1st and 2nd Lemoine circles, Apollonius circle, and Bevan circle.

collections.title: Mimosa Transforms
collections.summary: Centers generated by the Mimosa transform M(X) of classical triangle centers.

collections.title: Inverse Mimosa Transforms & Aleph Conjugates
collections.summary: Inverse Mimosa transforms of classical triangle centers and aleph conjugates.

collections.title: Zosma Transforms
collections.summary: Isogonal conjugates of the inverse Mimosa transforms (Z(X)) of classical triangle centers.

collections.title: Bicentric Pairs PU(k) & Orthocorrespondents
collections.summary: Midpoints, crosssums, crossdifferences, trilinear poles, and trilinear products of bicentric pairs PU(k) (X_1908–X_1982), Vega transforms, and orthocorrespondents (X_1992–X_2000).

collections.title: Orthocorrespondents, Gallatly Circle & Euler-Vecten-Gibert Points
collections.summary: Orthocorrespondents of classical centers (X_2001–X_2006), similicenters and intersections of the Gallatly circle (X_2007–X_2040), and the six Euler-Vecten-Gibert points and harmonic conjugates (X_2041–X_2054).

collections.title: Orion Transforms, Circumcircle Inverses, PK/NK Transforms, Reflections & Kepler Points
collections.summary: Orion transforms OT(X) (X_2055–X_2065), Caroli and Cursa points, circumcircle inverses (X_2070–X_2080), PK and NK transforms (X_2081–X_2092), classical reflections (X_2093–X_2105), and Kepler points and their isotomic conjugates (X_2106–X_2119).

collections.title: Eigencenters & Eigentransforms
collections.summary: Eigentransforms ET(X) — eigencenters of the cevian triangles of classical centers — paired with their isogonal conjugates on the self-isogonal cubic Z(X) (X_2120–X_2143), followed by X_2-eigentransforms (X_2144–X_2147).

collections.title: Isotomic Conjugates (X_2-Isoconjugates) I
collections.summary: Isotomic conjugates (X_2-isoconjugates) of triangle centers X_5 through X_892.

collections.title: Isotomic Conjugates (X_2-Isoconjugates) II
collections.summary: Isotomic conjugates (X_2-isoconjugates) of triangle centers X_901 through X_2099.

collections.title: Circumcircle CIR(X) Points & Gibert-Simson Transforms
collections.summary: Circumcevian-eigentransform points CIR(X) on the circumcircle and their isogonal conjugates (X_2365–X_2393), followed by Gibert-Simson transforms GS(X) on the Simson cubic K010 (X_2394–X_2419) and their isogonal conjugates on K162 (X_2420–X_2445).

collections.title: Circle & Conic Intersections, Lemoine Inverses & Radical Centers I
collections.summary: Intersections of central lines with the incircle, Bevan circle, Steiner inellipse, and Steiner circumellipse, inverses in the 1st and 2nd Lemoine circles, and circle radical centers (X_2446–X_2520).

collections.title: Circle Similicenters, Radical Centers & Isoconjugates II
collections.summary: Similicenters and intersections involving the orthocentroidal, 2nd Brocard, Parry, and Gallatly circles (X_2521–X_2573), followed by isogonal and X_k-isoconjugates (X_2574–X_2593).

collections.title: Bicentric Pairs PU(68)–PU(85) & Golden Arbelos Points
collections.summary: Sums, differences, crosssums, crossdifferences, trilinear poles, and midpoints of bicentric pairs PU(68) through PU(85) (X_2594–X_2670), together with the 1st and 2nd Golden Arbelos points (X_2671–X_2676).

collections.title: Rigby-Simson RS(P, U) & Simson-Rigby SR(P, U) Points
collections.summary: Rigby-Simson orthopoles RS(P, U) where the Simson lines of circumcircle points P and U meet (X_2677–X_2686), and Simson-Rigby circumcircle points SR(P, U) whose Simson lines pass through RS(P, U) perpendicular to PU (X_2687–X_2770).

collections.title: Isogonal Conjugates of Simson-Rigby SR(P, U) Points
collections.summary: Points on the line at infinity formed as the isogonal conjugates of the Simson-Rigby circumcircle points X_2687–X_2770.

collections.title: Simson-Moses SM(P, U) Points & Conjugates
collections.summary: Simson-Moses circumcircle points SM(P, U) generated by isotomic conjugation of circumcircle pairs (X_2855–X_2868) and their isogonal conjugates on the line at infinity (X_2869–X_2882).

collections.title: Isogonal Conjugates with Respect to Special Triangles
collections.summary: Complementary (medial-isogonal), anticomplementary-isogonal, tangential-isogonal, and excentral-isogonal conjugates of classical triangle centers, together with trilinear and barycentric products.

collections.title: MacBeath Points, Dual Centers DC(X) / CD(X) & Central Line Intersections
collections.summary: The eight MacBeath points (X_2967–X_2974), circle radical centers (X_2975–X_2978), dual triangle mappings DC(X) and CD(X) (X_2979–X_2998), the Danneels-Bevan homothetic center (X_2999), and the Soddy-antiorthic intersection (X_3000).

collections.title: Central Line Intersections, Stevanović Points & T/G Mappings
collections.summary: Pairwise intersections of the Brocard, de Longchamps, Gergonne, Lemoine, Nagel, orthic, Soddy, and Fermat axes (X_3001–X_3019), the 4th–10th Stevanović points (X_3020–X_3026), antipodal circle mappings and complements (X_3027–X_3111), and Quang Tuan Bui's TgX and GtX mappings (X_3112–X_3118).

collections.title: Danneels Perspectors & X_i-Ceva Conjugates
collections.summary: Eric Danneels' parallel-cevian perspectors (X_3119–X_3126) and a systematic catalog of X_i-Ceva conjugates of classical and central points (X_3127–X_3217).

collections.title: Side-Swapping SS(a → bc) Points, Parabola Vertices & Morley Equilateral Triangles
collections.summary: Side-swapping transformations SS(a → bc), vertices of the inscribed Kiepert and Yff parabolas (X_3233–X_3234), reflections in X_1 (X_3241–X_3245), and centers and perspectors of the six equilateral triangles related to the 1st, 2nd, and 3rd Morley triangles (X_3272–X_3283).

collections.title: Incircle Transforms T(U), Trigonometric Offset Points & Kiepert Cusps
collections.summary: Barycentric products of perpendicular directions (X_3310), incircle transforms T(U) lying on the incircle (X_3318–X_3328), Darboux-cubic reflections and conjugates (X_3341–X_3358), trigonometric phase-shifted centers cos/sin/sec/csc/tan/cot(A ± θ) (X_3364–X_3409), and the Brocard-Kiepert-Fermat cusps (X_3411–X_3414).

collections.title: Vertex Conjugates, Saragossa Points & Neuberg Cubic Intersections
collections.summary: U-vertex conjugates of X formed from circumcevian vertex triangles (X_3415–X_3458), 1st Saragossa points (X_3449–X_3454), X_5- and X_30-Ceva conjugates on the Neuberg cubic (X_3460–X_3488), and the 1st dilation center and its circumcircle inverse (X_3513–X_3514).

collections.title: Euler Line Intercepts & Named Geometric Centers
collections.summary: Euler line intercepts of central lines (X_3515–X_3552), together with the Dosa, Pappus, Moses circumcircle/infinity, Don Quixote, Beltrami-Euler, Beltrami-Parry, Myakishev conic, Dixit, Odehnal, and Liu points (X_3555–X_3601).

collections.title: Morley Cubics, Medial Homothetic Centers H(X; M, t) & Kirikami-Schiffler Points
collections.summary: Centers associated with the three Morley cubics K029–K031 (X_3602–X_3615), medial-triangle t-dilation homothetic centers H(X; M, t) and their isogonal conjugates H⁻¹(X; M, t) (X_3616–X_3637), Soddy-Gergonne, Kirikami, Alkaid, and Almach points (X_3638–X_3646), and Kirikami-Schiffler points KS(T) (X_3647–X_3662).

collections.title: Central Triangle Combos Xcom(T) I: Intouch, Extouch, Incentral & Hexyl Triangles
collections.summary: Combo centers X_k-com(T) evaluated on the intouch (X_3663–X_3677), extouch (X_3678–X_3719), incentral (X_3720–X_3728), excentral, tangential, 1st Brocard, and hexyl triangles (X_3729–X_3738), plus matrix-product combos n(incentral)*n(medial) and inverse-triangle combos (X_3739–X_3757).

collections.title: Central Triangle Combos Xcom(T) II: Parameterized T(f, g) & Euler Triangles
collections.summary: Combo centers X_k-com[T(f, g)] and X_k-com[Inverse(nT(f, g))] for parameterized central triangles (X_3758–X_3810), followed by combo centers on the 1st through 5th Euler triangles (X_3811–X_3861).

collections.title: Inverse Central Triangle Combos Xcom[Inverse(n(T))]
collections.summary: Perspectors of ABC and parameterized central triangles T(f, g) (X_3862–X_3867), inverse 3rd/4th/5th Euler triangle combos (X_3868–X_3910), and combos and inverse-triangle combos across the intouch, extouch, orthic, tangential, hexyl, Brocard, incentral, excentral, intangents, and extangents triangles (X_3911–X_4000).
